paragraphs.source_en: When a man is found dead, kicked by a camel, Allenby becomes a suspect and must try to solve the mystery himself. Complications and the apparent lack of motive befuddle and irritate him: "None of it fits together. It's like having several unrelated crimes squeezed into a short space of time on an absurd little spot in the desert. And besides that, everyone here just happens to have a ridiculous amount of Saharan expertise. It can't all be coincidence." Nor is it. Apart from the several plot twists that follow in this delightful, old-fashioned crime thriller, the story also evokes the loneliness of Tamanrasset, the destination for an incongruous group of foreigners.
